title: Red-first accepts a characterization task whose behaviour already holds
body:
Why: outside php row 1115h drained 73: lane t-04ewf93 refused because its task asked for a test of behaviour that already works, so no honest test is red at base (.krn/runs/outside/php.log:588-589); the proof line still said red-first 1 (php.log:590).
Outcome: a task whose Outcome adds tests for existing behaviour (characterization, no src change) passes the red-first arm when the diff touches only test files and the new tests pass at base and head; the lane brief tells the worker which mode applies; the proof line reports red-first only for tests that were actually red at base.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-brief.ts, src/cli/lane-run/verdict.ts, tests.
Proof: Stop test with a tests-only diff passing at base is green; a src change with no red-at-base test stays red; outside php row drains 0.
